rationale: Liu brings production data science expertise (Python, SQL, BI tools) while Matt leads AI infrastructure efforts across major open-source foundations—creating a natural complement for building data-driven AI systems. intro_message: Liu Nils, meet Matt White — Matt's global CTO role across AI/ML infrastructure foundations pairs well with your data science and automation expertise for exploring how modern AI systems handle data pipelines and analytics.
